Coding-specific. For adding standalone agents, use `create-agent`.

availableCommands.name: lark-tools
availableCommands.description: [Skill] Feishu/Lark full-capability access via the official `lark-cli` (terminal) plus native local-runtime Feishu channel binding/status. Use this skill whenever the user mentions anything related to Feishu or Lark, including but not limited to: checking today's schedule or a specific date's agenda, creating calendar events, querying free/busy status, viewing or creating tasks, searching group chats, reading chat history, sending or replying to messages, looking up contacts or user details, querying or writing Bitable (multi-dimensional table) records, searching documents, or running any lark-cli subcommand. ALSO use this skill to READ or OPEN a Feishu/Lark document, wiki, sheet, or Base from a link — any `feishu.cn`, `larksuite.com`, or `*.feishu.cn` URL (including `/docx/`, `/wiki/`, `/sheets/`, `/base/`, `/w000/`, `/file/` paths), even when the user just pastes the bare URL without saying "Feishu". Route by link type, NOT `webfetch`: a doc/docx/wiki link → `lark-cli docs +fetch` (it resolves both docx and wiki URLs); a `/sheets/` link → `lark-cli sheets +read`; a `/base/` (Bitable) link → `lark-cli base +record-list`. Feishu serves an anti-bot/ad page to plain HTTP fetchers, so `webfetch` on a `feishu.cn` / `larksuite.com` URL returns garbage; switch to this skill when that happens. Even if the user simply says "check my schedule", "send a message to someone", "find a doc about X", "read this feishu doc", or "look up who Zhang San is", this skill applies. Also use it when encountering 401 / LARK_USER_AUTH_REQUIRED errors — this skill handles the auth flow.

availableCommands.name: llm-call
availableCommands.description: [Skill] Call a configured LLM model directly through the local script using provider settings from config.yaml. Use this skill when the user wants a raw model call, prompt test, provider/model comparison, or asks to send text to a specific GPT/Gemini model. Do not use it for normal Mavis agent execution.

availableCommands.name: mcode-tools-master
availableCommands.description: [Skill] You must load this skill before running any `mcode-tools` Bash command. The `mcode-tools` CLI is available on PATH and serves two purposes: (1) multimodal generation and understanding, including images/photos, video, audio, music, and documents; (2) discovering, inspecting, and calling all App/Connector tools (App = Connector), including ordinary connected App requests, scripts, and batch automation. For multimodal generation or understanding requests, load this skill and use mcode-tools through Bash. App tools are not injected into the model tool list. Ordinary MCP and Plugin-owned MCP tools already in the model tool list can still be called directly. Load this skill when the user asks to use a named App/service, or specialized external or connected-account data may require App discovery before general web search.
